name: JTF_RS_RES_PRIMARY_ORG
description: This table stores the primary organization of resource for a classification. A primary organization can be set only when resource is a member of that Organization.

columns.name: RES_PRIM_ORG_REC_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Resource Organization Membership. Primary Key.

columns.name: PRIMARY_ORG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the primary resource organization for the classification stored in the CLASSIFICATION_ID column.  Yeste that this column stores a unique identifier to the HCM common organization modeling a resource organization. PK to HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_F.ORGANIZATION_ID

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the HCM common organization classification for which the resource organization is primary for a resource. FK to HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F.CLASSIFICATION_ID

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: HCM common organization classification code stored in CLASSIFICATION_ID column, for which the resource organization is primary for the resource. FK to HR_ORG_UNIT_CLASSIFICATIONS_F.CLASSIFICATION_CODE

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the resource party. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID.

columns.name: DELETE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the primary resource organization association has been deleted.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
